description: Find DJs on DJfindr, narrowed by occasion, genre, location, budget, rating or a specific date. This is the starting point for almost any request: call it before get_dj, which needs an id or slug this returns. Genre, occasion and extra are SLUGS (list_reference has them); an unrecognised slug matches nothing rather than erroring, so check rather than guess. Returns a short summary per DJ.

available_on.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD. Excludes DJs already blocked that day.

city.description: City name, used with state when no place key is known.

extra.description: Extra slugs, e.g. mc-services. Multiple means any of them.

genre.description: Genre slugs. Multiple means any of them.

hourly_rate_max.description: Maximum hourly rate in CENTS. $250/hr is 25000.

occasion.description: Occasion slug, e.g. wedding. The single most useful filter.

place_key.description: Place key or city slug from list_locations.

q.description: Free text matched against name and bio. Keep it under 48 characters.

sort.description: Leave it out for the order DJfindr itself uses: Platinum DJs first, then the highest rating (platinum_rating). Use rate_asc for budget questions, rating for "best" by score alone, random for a fresh mix of matches on each call.

name: search_djs
title: Search DJs
